import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Bead sase-14n.12 is done and closed.

**Fix:** a custom gate request declaring a `shell` block but omitting `continuation_mode` defaulted to `"none"`, which silently discarded the shell at creation (envelope kept the block, mode `none`, no gate-shell row, gate missing from `sase gate list`). In [model_request.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_32/src/sase/notification_gates/model_request.py:264) a shell block with no explicit mode now derives `"gate_shell"` (matching sudo), and shell plus explicit `"none"` is rejected with a clear error. [validation.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_32/src/sase/notification_gates/validation.py:54) backstops directly-constructed specs the same way. Rejection-in-`create_gate` was deliberately avoided: the repo's own tests establish `create_gate`+shell envelope persistence as a supported low-level constructor, with row registration owned by the `create_gate_shell` transaction. One-sentence doc note in `docs/notifications.md`.

**Tests:** 5 new tests in [tests/gate_shell/test_model_shell.py](/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/sase-org/sase/sase_32/tests/gate_shell/test_model_shell.py:131) — derive, reject, explicit-mode passthrough, `none` default without shell, and recorded mode plus row presence via the real store. A scratch repro confirmed the exact reported symptom before the fix and the derived mode after.

**Verification:** recorded `sase tool run check` — all lint gates green (incl. symvision, mypy), 44232 passed. The only failures were 4 gate-unrelated tests that flake under box load (avg 44+) and pass in isolation; recorded as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP` note for the land agent. Note: the new test lives in the existing module rather than a new file because a new file tipped the shard-timing drift guard (20.01% vs 20% bound) on otherwise pre-existing growth; the guard is green with no new files. `epic-symbols` was clean, and the SASE final declaration was accepted.
